clues.text: This Persian king reigned from the citadel of Susa over 127 provinces stretching from India to Cush.
When Queen Vashti refused to come before him at his command, this Persian king burned with fury.
This Persian king loved Esther more than all the other young women and set the royal crown on her head.
This Persian king took the signet ring from his finger and handed it to Haman, the enemy of the Jews.
Persian royal records showed that Mordecai had exposed two eunuchs who plotted to assassinate this king.
Told of the gallows Haman built for Mordecai, this Persian king declared, "Hang him on it!"
This Persian king held out his gold scepter toward Queen Esther, and she rose to stand before him.
